technology_name_fr: Capacité max CCGT avec captage CO₂ (Wallonie)
note_complementaire: inf -> 0 MW. No carbon capture on Walloon gas-fired power plants, existing and new (cabinet meeting 2026-09-24; scope confirmed 2026-09-29: 'on maintient bien le CCS sur process et on ne permet pas la capture sur centrales gaz (existantes et nouvelles)'). TIMES drops the CCGT CCS retrofit of the two recent units and the new post-combustion CCGT; TIMES-WAL has no gas CHP with capture, so the CHP variant is capped too. Industrial capture, biomass CHP CC and every non-Walloon node are untouched, as in the other sensitivities. docs/logs/2026-09-30_cabinet_batch_20260930_2010_1h.md §2.5.
